feeds.title: Joceli Mayer
feeds.description: This blog is about DSP. Links, demonstrations, and discussions on fundamentals of Digital Signal Processing. The posts aim to help students and practitioners as well as to motivate people to understand and apply DSP algorithms. Joceli Mayer is a Professor of Electrical Engineering from the Federal University of Santa Catarina, Brazil.

feeds.title: The Numerix-DSP Blog
feeds.description: The Numerix-DSP Blog discusses all things DSP, AI, ML, IoT, and more. Author Real Gone Geeks is a Telecommunications Engineer and they write about an array of topics related to Signal Processing some of them being DSP using TensorFlow, DSP in C/C++, and the fundamentals.
